description: Wormhole NoC Route Configuration Table (RCT) register specification. Each DRAM reader's T-tile has a local RCT that configures the NoC data path between the reader and its assigned DRAM bank. The firmware programs the RCT by writing two 32-bit words to the register.

fields.name: target_x
fields.description: Target DRAM bank tile X coordinate (0-9)

fields.name: target_y
fields.description: Target DRAM bank tile Y coordinate (0-11)

fields.name: dram_addr_offset
fields.description: DRAM bank address offset (typically 0 for base access)

risc_v_target.description: Tenstorrent T-tiles contain RV32IM Baby RISC-V cores. Firmware is assembled with riscv64-linux-gnu-as targeting -march=rv32i -mabi=ilp32.
risc_v_target.programming_sequence: Use lui to load RCT base address, li to load config value, sw to write the 32-bit register words.
